ecommerce.title: Enterprise E-commerce Platform
ecommerce.shortDescription: Scalable e-commerce system with microservices architecture

engineer.description: Microservices architecture with .NET Core 8 and Angular 17, designed with Domain-Driven Design and Event Storming. Payment system integrated with Stripe and real-time inventory management.
highlights: API Gateway with Ocelot + Redis Cache for 50k req/min
5 Bounded Contexts identified (Catalog, Orders, Payments, Inventory, Users)
60% reduction in response times vs. previous monolith

task-manager-ddd.title: Task Manager with DDD
task-manager-ddd.shortDescription: Enterprise task manager with clean architecture and DDD

engineer.description: Full-stack application with Clean Architecture, CQRS and Event Sourcing. Backend in .NET 8 and frontend in Angular with NgRx. Complex domain design with multiple aggregates and state machines.
highlights: CQRS implementation with MediatR and Event Sourcing
3 main Aggregates (Task, Project, Team) with UML and C4 documentation

engineer.description: Distributed system with 8 independent microservices. Asynchronous communication with RabbitMQ and synchronization with gRPC, from a zero-downtime monolith decomposition strategy.
highlights: API Gateway with JWT authentication and rate limiting
Gradual migration strategy: Saga, API Composition, CQRS patterns
Observability with Prometheus, Grafana and Seq for logs

caso-arquitectura.title: Case Study: Systems Analyst
caso-arquitectura.shortDescription: Full systems-analysis cycle for an architecture firm: requirements gathering, UML, DFD and 13 Scrum sprints

engineer.description: Interactive case study covering the full systems-analysis cycle: requirements gathering, feasibility study, objectives and scope, requirements, modeling (UML, ERD, DFD, state diagram), architecture design, and a Scrum methodology with 13 documented sprints.
highlights: 14 navigable chapters: from initial requirements gathering to production rollout
Custom-built diagrams (class, use case, ERD, DFD, state, deployment) instead of static screenshots
Full backlog, burndown, and traceability between requirements and delivered features

mundial-2026.title: 2026 World Cup prediction model
mundial-2026.shortDescription: Elo rating, Poisson and Monte Carlo simulation to estimate each team's probability, validated against the real tournament

engineer.description: Relative strength model (Elo), expected goals (Poisson) and full bracket Monte Carlo simulation. Strict time cutoff: no prediction uses information after the tournament started.
highlights: Predicted both semifinals correctly and ranked Spain 2nd favorite (16%); Spain won
Elo calibration validated on thousands of historical matches
Honest comparison against logistic baseline and naive lines (log-loss)

abandono-estudiantil.title: Student dropout prediction
abandono-estudiantil.shortDescription: Risk model to prioritize tutoring: who to intervene with first when resources are limited

engineer.description: Pilot (POC) on the UCI dataset (4,424 students). Logistic regression vs. Random Forest, decision threshold as a business dial and a prioritized student list.
highlights: Detects 65.8% of dropouts with only the 1st semester, in time to intervene
Operational threshold 0.53 optimized by F1 (precision 0.88, recall 0.72)
Full CRISP-DM journey with management artifacts (Sprint 0, DRL sheet, backlog)
